verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a broad API surface (payments, refunds, webhooks, idempotency, OAuth, reconciliation reports, platforms/sub-entity management, fraud rules, testing) that mirrors most Dashboard functionality, and even exposes an MCP server for agent-driven payment operations. However, there is no explicit statement of full UI/API parity, and some flows (Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links, Flow low-code) are framed as UI-first conveniences, while account/pricing setup remains sales-led rather than API-configurable. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee/documentation and API endpoints for dashboard-only admin tasks (pricing plan setup, some fraud rule configuration).
